# Engineering brief: search and tags (isolated in a worktree)

## Outcome
Engineers can find notes by text and group them with tags, without destabilising `main` while the feature is built.

## Scope
- `tags`: optional list of strings on create and PATCH; normalised to lowercase, unique, sorted; `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9:._-]{0,29}`; max 10 per note. PATCH without `tags` keeps existing tags.
- `GET /api/notes?q=<text>`: case-insensitive substring match on title **or** body. `%` and `_` must match literally.
- `GET /api/notes?tag=<tag>`: notes with that tag. `q` and `tag` combine with AND.
- Invalid tag or query longer than 100 characters → `400`.

## Isolation rules
1. Start a worktree session: `claude --worktree search-tags` (branch `worktree-search-tags` under `.claude/worktrees/`).
2. All edits happen in the worktree. `main` stays untouched and runnable.
3. Before merging, the human reviews `git diff main...worktree-search-tags`, runs the full test suite in the worktree, and inspects any file outside `notes_api/` and `tests/`.
4. Merge with a focused commit message. Remove the worktree afterwards.

## Constraints
- Standard library only. Keep the layering: SQL only in `repository.py`, rules only in `service.py`.
- Existing tests must pass unchanged.

"""Tests for note tags and the q/tag filters on GET /api/notes."""

import json
import sys
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notes_api.repository import NoteRepository  # noqa: E402
from notes_api.server import make_handler  # noqa: E402
from notes_api.service import NoteService, ValidationError  # noqa: E402


class TagTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.service = NoteService(NoteRepository(":memory:"))

    def test_tags_normalised_unique_sorted(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["Beta", "alpha", "BETA", "v1.4:rc_1-x"]})
        self.assertEqual(note["tags"], ["alpha", "beta", "v1.4:rc_1-x"])

    def test_default_tags_empty(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.service.create({"title": "a"})["tags"], [])

    def test_invalid_tags_rejected(self) -> None:
        for bad in ["", " x", "-x", "a b", "a" * 31, "é", 5, "x\n"]:
            with self.subTest(tag=bad), self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
                self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": [bad]})
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": "release"})

    def test_tag_length_boundary(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["a" * 30]})["tags"], ["a" * 30])

    def test_max_ten_tags(self) -> None:
        ten = [f"t{i}" for i in range(10)]
        self.assertEqual(len(self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ten})["tags"]), 10)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ten + ["t10"]})

    def test_patch_without_tags_keeps_them(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["x"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.update(note["id"], {"title": "b"})["tags"], ["x"])

    def test_patch_replaces_and_clears_tags(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["x"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.update(note["id"], {"tags": ["Z", "y"]})["tags"], ["y", "z"])
        self.assertEqual(self.service.update(note["id"], {"tags": []})["tags"], [])

    def test_patch_invalid_tags_rejected_and_unchanged(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["x"]})
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.update(note["id"], {"tags": ["bad tag"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.get(note["id"])["tags"], ["x"])


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.service = NoteService(NoteRepository(":memory:"))
        mk = self.service.create
        self.rollback = mk({"title": "Rollback plan", "body": "redeploy v1.3", "tags": ["release", "ops"]})
        self.percent = mk({"title": "Coverage 100%", "body": "all good", "tags": ["release"]})
        self.plain = mk({"title": "Coverage 1000", "body": "nothing"})
        self.under = mk({"title": "snake_case", "body": "naming"})
        self.other = mk({"title": "snakeXcase", "body": "naming"})
        self.slash = mk({"title": "path a\\b", "body": "", "tags": ["ops"]})

    def ids(self, **kw) -> set[int]:
        return {n["id"] for n in self.service.list(**kw)}

    def test_no_filters_returns_all(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(len(self.service.list()), 6)

    def test_case_insensitive_title_or_body(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="ROLLBACK"), {self.rollback["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="REDEPLOY"), {self.rollback["id"]})

    def test_percent_is_literal(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="100%"), {self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="%"), {self.percent["id"]})

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="snake_case"), {self.under["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="_"), {self.under["id"]})

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="a\\b"), {self.slash["id"]})

    def test_tag_filter(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="release"), {self.rollback["id"], self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="RELEASE"), {self.rollback["id"], self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="missing"), set())

    def test_q_and_tag_combine_with_and(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="coverage", tag="release"), {self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="snake", tag="release"), set())

    def test_limits_and_invalid(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="a" * 100), set())
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.list(q="a" * 101)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.list(tag="bad tag")

    def test_deleted_note_leaves_tag_index(self) -> None:
        self.service.delete(self.percent["id"])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="release"), {self.rollback["id"]})


class HttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        service = NoteService(NoteRepository(":memory:"))
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), make_handler(service))
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.addCleanup(self.server.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(self.server.shutdown)
        self.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}/api/notes"

    def call(self, url: str, method: str = "GET", payload: dict | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:
        data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read())

    def test_query_string_filters(self) -> None:
        self.call(self.base, "POST", {"title": "Coverage 100%", "tags": ["Release"]})
        self.call(self.base, "POST", {"title": "Coverage 1000"})
        status, notes = self.call(f"{self.base}?q={quote('100%')}&tag=release")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual([n["title"] for n in notes], ["Coverage 100%"])

    def test_bad_query_and_tag_return_400(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.call(f"{self.base}?q={'a' * 101}")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.call(f"{self.base}?tag={quote('bad tag')}")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.call(self.base, "POST", {"title": "x", "tags": ["bad tag"]})[0], 400)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

**What changed**

- **`server.py`:** parses `q` and `tag` from the query string and passes them to the service.

**Tests** (`tests/test_search_tags.py`) cover:
- tag normalisation, the 30-character and 10-tag boundaries, and PATCH keep, replace and clear;
- case-insensitive search on title or body, and literal `%`, `_` and `\` (for example `q=_` matches `snake_case` but not `snakeXcase`);
- AND combination of `q` and `tag`, and 400 responses over HTTP.

**Decisions to check in review**
- An empty `?q=` or `?tag=` is treated as no filter.
- The 10-tag limit applies after de-duplication.
- Case-insensitive search relies on SQLite's `LIKE`, which only ignores case for ASCII letters, so `ä` won't match `Ä`.
- `tests/test_search_tags.py` uses classes named `TagTests`, `SearchTests` and `HttpTests`. The rules file in `.claude/rules/tests.md` asks for one class per behaviour, so those classes may need splitting.

"""Tests for note tags and the q/tag filters on GET /api/notes."""

import json
import sys
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from notes_api.repository import NoteRepository  # noqa: E402
from notes_api.server import make_handler  # noqa: E402
from notes_api.service import NoteService, ValidationError  # noqa: E402


class TagTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.service = NoteService(NoteRepository(":memory:"))

    def test_tags_normalised_unique_sorted(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["Beta", "alpha", "BETA", "v1.4:rc_1-x"]})
        self.assertEqual(note["tags"], ["alpha", "beta", "v1.4:rc_1-x"])

    def test_default_tags_empty(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.service.create({"title": "a"})["tags"], [])

    def test_invalid_tags_rejected(self) -> None:
        for bad in ["", " x", "-x", "a b", "a" * 31, "é", 5, "x\n"]:
            with self.subTest(tag=bad), self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
                self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": [bad]})
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": "release"})

    def test_tag_length_boundary(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["a" * 30]})["tags"], ["a" * 30])

    def test_max_ten_tags(self) -> None:
        ten = [f"t{i}" for i in range(10)]
        self.assertEqual(len(self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ten})["tags"]), 10)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ten + ["t10"]})

    def test_patch_without_tags_keeps_them(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["x"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.update(note["id"], {"title": "b"})["tags"], ["x"])

    def test_patch_replaces_and_clears_tags(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["x"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.update(note["id"], {"tags": ["Z", "y"]})["tags"], ["y", "z"])
        self.assertEqual(self.service.update(note["id"], {"tags": []})["tags"], [])

    def test_patch_invalid_tags_rejected_and_unchanged(self) -> None:
        note = self.service.create({"title": "a", "tags": ["x"]})
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.update(note["id"], {"tags": ["bad tag"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.service.get(note["id"])["tags"], ["x"])


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.service = NoteService(NoteRepository(":memory:"))
        mk = self.service.create
        self.rollback = mk({"title": "Rollback plan", "body": "redeploy v1.3", "tags": ["release", "ops"]})
        self.percent = mk({"title": "Coverage 100%", "body": "all good", "tags": ["release"]})
        self.plain = mk({"title": "Coverage 1000", "body": "nothing"})
        self.under = mk({"title": "snake_case", "body": "naming"})
        self.other = mk({"title": "snakeXcase", "body": "naming"})
        self.slash = mk({"title": "path a\\b", "body": "", "tags": ["ops"]})

    def ids(self, **kw) -> set[int]:
        return {n["id"] for n in self.service.list(**kw)}

    def test_no_filters_returns_all(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(len(self.service.list()), 6)

    def test_case_insensitive_title_or_body(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="ROLLBACK"), {self.rollback["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="REDEPLOY"), {self.rollback["id"]})

    def test_percent_is_literal(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="100%"), {self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="%"), {self.percent["id"]})

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="snake_case"), {self.under["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="_"), {self.under["id"]})

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="a\\b"), {self.slash["id"]})

    def test_tag_filter(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="release"), {self.rollback["id"], self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="RELEASE"), {self.rollback["id"], self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="missing"), set())

    def test_q_and_tag_combine_with_and(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="coverage", tag="release"), {self.percent["id"]})
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="snake", tag="release"), set())

    def test_limits_and_invalid(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(q="a" * 100), set())
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.list(q="a" * 101)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.service.list(tag="bad tag")

    def test_deleted_note_leaves_tag_index(self) -> None:
        self.service.delete(self.percent["id"])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids(tag="release"), {self.rollback["id"]})


class HttpTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        service = NoteService(NoteRepository(":memory:"))
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), make_handler(service))
        threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        self.addCleanup(self.server.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(self.server.shutdown)
        self.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_address[1]}/api/notes"

    def call(self, url: str, method: str = "GET", payload: dict | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:
        data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read())

    def test_query_string_filters(self) -> None:
        self.call(self.base, "POST", {"title": "Coverage 100%", "tags": ["Release"]})
        self.call(self.base, "POST", {"title": "Coverage 1000"})
        status, notes = self.call(f"{self.base}?q={quote('100%')}&tag=release")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual([n["title"] for n in notes], ["Coverage 100%"])

    def test_bad_query_and_tag_return_400(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.call(f"{self.base}?q={'a' * 101}")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.call(f"{self.base}?tag={quote('bad tag')}")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.call(self.base, "POST", {"title": "x", "tags": ["bad tag"]})[0], 400)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
